close_reason: Replaced N serial get_objects calls with one batch call; collected results into HashMap<Id,Email> for O(1) keyword lookup per entry.
description: handle_mdn_send Step 5 (mdn.rs lines 325-348) iterates over send_map and calls backend.get_objects::<Email>() once per entry — N serial round-trips for N MDNs. get_objects already accepts a slice of IDs, so all N IDs could be fetched in a single call, then the results correlated by ID. For MDN/send the batch is typically 1, but a well-designed handler should use the batch API it was given. Impact at scale: linear latency multiplication on any backend with non-trivial per-call overhead.
title: N serial get_objects calls in mdnsent pre-check of handle_mdn_send
